newsitem.title: HUNGARY: SOLTI NAMED HONORARY HEAD OF BUDAPEST ORCHESTRA.
newsitem.headline: SOLTI NAMED HONORARY HEAD OF BUDAPEST ORCHESTRA.

text.p: Hungarian-born maestro Sir Georg Solti, 85, has been named conductor emeritus of the Budapest Festival Orchestra, the orchestra announced.
Solti, who last conducted the orchestra in 1995, will conduct a concert with the ensemble in March 1998, the organisation announced in a press release on Tuesday.
Solti, who took up British nationality in 1972, is renowned as a conductor of opera and has been accepting bookings beyond the millenium.
